jobs.occupation: Development Lead for the Helmholtz Cloud portal (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Development Lead for the Helmholtz Cloud portal

Limited: 2 years | Starting date: 01.10.2026 | ID: FHMA020/2026 | Deadline: 02.09.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

In that capacity, DESY is member of the German Helmholtz Research Association, a group of 19 independent research centers all over Germany, providing a world-class science infrastructure, focusing on the major societal challenges of our time, covering areas like climate change, energy transition, transport in the future and the battle against severe and widespread diseases. In order to most efficiently use its distributed IT resources and expertise and at the same time reduce the energy footprint, the Association is operating the Helmholtz Federated Services, in short, HIFIS. The platform provides a seamless and powerful ICT infrastructure to the entire Helmholtz scientific community. Within HIFIS, DESY is responsible for the implementation of the central Cloud Portal, making firstclass distributed cloud services available and easily accessible to the 42 000 employees of all Helmholtz centres and, whenever possible, to external scientific collaboration partners.

About your role:

As a Scientist, you take the responsibility to lead the implementation and functional development of a Helmholtz-wide Cloud Portal.

- You will lead the implementation and further functional development of the novel Helmholtz-wide Cloud Portal, providing access to distributed compute data and other cloud services to all Helmholtz centres, their scientists and collaboration partners
- You will lead a small, geographically distributed team of developers to implement and further improve the portal
- You will lead the evaluation and definition of necessary technical interfaces, in the areas of AAI, monitoring/accounting and resource management, to seamlessly integrate all cloud service offerings into the portal and make all services easily accessible
- You will be the contact of your team to other HIFIS groups and to groups outside of HIFIS, working on similar endeavors

About you:

- You own a university degree in computer science, physics, mathematics or equivalent
- You have a good knowledge in distributed cloud services and federated core services, like portals and single sign-on authentication
- You have basic knowledge in the areas of Cloud Management Frameworks, distributed Data Management, Authentication and identity Management
- You are able to translate technical designs into comprehensible visions and successfully communicate those visions to your coworkers and stakeholders
- You have a good spoken and written command of the English language
- You are motivated by leading geographically distributed teams and ideally already have experience with this
- The successful candidate should be willing to undertake occasional business travel within Germany

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work‑life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Uwe Jandt at +49 40 8998‑4105 (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/128404/2/3319)  **(uwe.jandt@desy.de (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/128404/2/3320) ).**

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates).

jobs.occupation: Healthcare Therapy Area Insights (all genders) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

Your Role:

At the intersection of science, strategy, and commercial impact, this role places you at the heart of some of the most consequential decisions in healthcare drug development and commercialization. As an Associate Director within the Global Strategic Insights function, you will serve as a trusted thought partner to therapy area commercial teams — translating complex market dynamics into clear, actionable intelligence that shapes how healthcare assets are launched, grown, and managed across major global markets.

This role will interact primarily with the Rare Tumor and Specialty Therapy Area teams, partnering closely with colleagues who are driving some of the most strategically significant assets in the portfolio.

You will own the end-to-end delivery of insights across one or more GSI disciplines (primary market research, competitive intelligence, or strategic forecasting), ensuring every recommendation is grounded in rigorous analysis and directly informs critical business decisions.

Working with cross-functional partners across commercial strategy, market access and pricing, other GSI functions, and regional insights teams, you will drive insights that elevate decision quality at critical stages of the asset lifecycle.

Who You Are :

- A degree in life sciences, business, economics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience — is required.
- 5 or more years of experience in at least one global strategic insights discipline — primary market research, competitive intelligence, data analytics, or strategic forecasting — ideally within the pharmaceutical or biopharma industry.
- You have designed and led insights and KPI workstreams for in-market or launch assets, with at least 2 years of direct experience across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch phases.
- You hold deep expertise in one or more of the following: qualitative and quantitative primary market research (study design, discussion guide development, strategic recommendations); global competitive intelligence (trial monitoring, congress coverage, strategic simulation); or topline forecasting (model building, opportunity assessment, scenario analysis).
- You have global experience across two or more major markets — such as the US, China, EU4 and UK, or Japan — and bring a nuanced understanding of how market dynamics differ across regions.
- You work effectively across functions, with a solid understanding of how commercial strategy, market access and pricing, and regional insights teams each contribute to asset success.
- You are comfortable navigating the full medicine lifecycle — from proof-of-concept through in-market management — and understand how insights activities evolve at each stage.
- You communicate complex findings with clarity and confidence, translating analytical outputs into compelling narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders and drive informed decisions.
- English fluent, additional languages are a plus

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Machine Learning (m/f/d) - TV-L E 13, 100% (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Universität Hildesheim
Stiftung des öffentlichen Rechts

Job advertisement
Reference number 2026/121

The following position is to be filled at the Institute of Computer Science,
Information Systems and Machine Learning Lab (ISMLL) has a vacancy for a

PhD Position in Machine Learning (m/f/d)
(TV-L E 13, 100%)

the position is full-time, can be filled immediately, and is initially
offered for three years. The salary is according to TV-L E13 (roughly 57,000
EUR gross income per year).

As a PhD student in our international ML research group you conduct research
in ML guided by a postdoc and two professors, have the opportunity to cooperate
with companies, small and large, as well as with academic partners on real-word
ML problems, and are encouraged to assist in teaching ML courses in our
renowned International Master‘s Program in Data Analytics to students from all
over the world. The working language of our group is English. You will work in
a beautiful town with UNESCO World Heritage Sites, located in the very center
of Germany, just 30 km from Hanover and 1.5 hours. by high-speed train to Berlin

Who we are:

The Information Systemsand Machine Learning Lab (ISMLL) at the Institute of
Computer Science of the University of Hildesheim is an international research
group an machine learning, especially predictive modelling and probabilistic
methods for complex data and complex decisions, with an excellent publication
track record (NeurlPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, ACM KDD, ECML PKDD, etc.). Current
research directions include time series forecasting, probabilistic machine
learning, graph neural networks, recommender systems, and mathematical
foundations of machine learning. ISMLL takes part in basic and applied research
projects in various domains such as mobility, e-commerce, and
technologyenhanced learning. Seehttp://www.ismll.uni-hildesheim.defor more
information. The Institute of Computer Science, of which ISMLL is part, has a
streng focus on artificial intelligence, with three chairs working in this
field. The University of Hildesheim is renowned for high-quality research and
education.

What we expect:

We are looking for a gifted student who loves models, algorithms, and data,
can hardly stop discussing them with others, likes to express their ideas in
formulas and programs, and now wants to get to the bottom of a complex ML
problem over the next three years. You should have a recent Master's degree in
Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a closely related
area. A Master's thesis on an ML topic and ML-related courses in your Master's
program will be an asset. You are expected to have strong analytic and
programming skills, the ability to work independently, and strong interpersonal
as weil as English language skills.

As a family-friendly university, we offer a varied, interdisciplinary range
of tasks, flexible working hours, regular further and advanced training and a
special annual payment within the framework of TV-L. In joining the university,
you will become part of a dynamic, committed and open-minded team.

The University of Hildesheim has adopted a mission statement that places
great importance on gender equality and diversity.

The University of Hildesheim particularly wants to promote the professional
equality of women and men. Therefore, it aims to increase the proportion of
employees of the gender that is underrepresented in the respective area.

In the case of equal qualification and suitability, applications from
applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration.

For university degrees obtained abroad, a certificate evaluation by the
Central Office for Foreign Education (ZAB) is required as proof of equivalence
before you are hired. Please apply for this in good time if necessary. You can
find more information athttps://zab.kmk.org/de/zeugnisbewertung.

Until when and how to apply
Please apply online using reference number 2026/121 at
https://www.ismll.uni-hildesheim.de/apply/, uploading your CV with your
transcripts and a research statement. Please enclose a PDF of a technical text
of yours, such as a first paper, your Master's thesis, or a seminar paper you
wrote. You can submit your application online at any time; once we have found
our new .PhD student, the application portal will be closed. We will store and
process your personal data during the application process and delete it
afterwards. For any further questions, please contact Prof. Dr. Dr. Lars
Schmidt-Thieme (schmidt-thieme@ismll.uni-hildesheim.de) or Prof. Dr. Tom Hanika
(tom.hanika@uni-hildesheim.de) via email.

jobs.occupation: Contracts Manager/Vertragsjurist/-in II (d/f/m) (Jurist/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for

Vertragsjurist / Procurement Contracts Manager (d/m/w)

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Procurement Contracts Manager (m/f) to join our "Procurement Contracts department" dedicated to the Space Systems Business line. The successful candidate will be based in Bremen, Germany.

Are you ready to shape the future of aerospace and defense? Join our diverse, international team of 30+ Contract Managers and become a vital part of our Air Power, Space, and Connected Intelligence divisions. Join a dedicated team that acts every day true to the global Airbus purpose: “We pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world”.

Here, you won't just manage contracts, you will provide the strategic expertise that powers our Procurement function and supports the development of next-generation Space Systems for global commercial and governmental customers. You will work at the intersection of innovation and execution, collaborating closely with experts in Sales, Finance, Legal, and Export Control.

If you are looking for a high-impact role in a supportive, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you.

** Your Location**

Bremen is a charming, historic city in the northwest of Germany. It is not only one of the greenest cities in the country, but also offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. The city is also a great place for coastal lovers, as it is only a one-hour drive away from the North Sea coast.

** Our Benefits for you**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive salary and individual additional benefits, e.g. company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g. bicycle leasing) or employee advantages at cooperating companies in accordance with our valid guidelines.
- Time for you (and your relatives): 30 days of annual leave according to the collective agreement (35h/week); compatibility of family & career (flextime, mobile working, part-time, job sharing, sabbatical).
- Easy Progression: Excellent further training opportunities and international, group-wide development perspectives.
- Well-being at work: Company doctor; comprehensive health offers (sports courses, prevention offers, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, partly near-site kindergarten.
- Diversity connects: Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, support and diversity are lived.

** Your Tasks and Responsibilities**

- Act as the Procurement Contract Manager (“PCM”) Focal Point for applicable Space Systems business activities and programs, mainly in Germany,
- Provide the support and drive your advice of Call for Tenders (CFTs) by challenging/assessing/approving the contractual baselines, assessing the contractual elements of bids, preparing/supporting the negotiations and overseeing the contract awards,
- Prepare, perform and lead contract drafting and negotiations in close collaboration with the Procurement function,
- Approve and sign the Contract Validation Form (CVF) ensuring all key elements - including executive summaries, deviations, risks, and opportunities - are accurately captured and approved, prior to any Airbus final signature,
- Hand in hands with the Procurement function, oversee and manage the contract lifecycle, including: preparation, drafting and negotiation of complex contracts, amendments, claims and settlement agreements, and other key contractual documents,
- Mitigate contractual risks by providing contractual expert analysis and advice during disagreements or potential disputes between Airbus and our partners, suppliers,
- Provide support for the preparation/defense of claims and pre-litigation matters,
- Provide cross-functional expertise in contract design, drafting, and negotiation for Airbus departments outside of the Procurement function,
- Advise internal stakeholders on the contractual implications of strategic projects, specifically, but not only, regarding confidentiality and Intellectual Property (IP),
- Develop new and further development of existing Procurement Academy training; coaching and training-on-the-job of our stakeholders in the areas of contracts management and negotiations,
- In the objectives to enhance performance and agility, standardize procurement excellence by proposing, drafting and revising standard contracts that integrate economic, commercial, technological, legal, and risk management requirements.

** Required Skills and Qualifications**

- You hold a successfully completed university degree (Master's level) in Legal and/or Business Administration or equivalent, with experience in Contact Management, Business Law, or a comparable experience.
- You possess a good experience in Contract Management as well as in the legally secure drafting and design of procurement agreements (3+ years).
- You communicate at a fully negotiation-proof level in German and have fluent English language skills to cooperate effectively in an international context. German language is mandatory.
- Your are open-minded, self-motivated team-player, you provide a “Can Do” attitude who enjoys finding solutions to contractual issues / challenges,
- You are Customer oriented, with excellent communication and collaboration skills,
- Analytical and rigorous, able to break-down and explain complex topics to a variety of stakeholders,
- Pragmatic, able to balance contractual and business risks, priorities, oversights and compliance,
- Willing to take on big and small tasks, ranging from operational support to strategic projects.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal development with tailored development solutions. Take your career to the next level and apply online now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Scientist (m/w/d) (Pharmazeut/in)
jobs.employer_name: Proteome Sciences R&D GmbH & Co KG
jobs.description:
Proteome Sciences plc (www.proteomics.com) is a global leader in applied proteomics with scientific operations based in Frankfurt am Main (Germany) and San Diego (CA, USA). We partner with innovative companies and academic research groups and offer high sensitivity, proprietary technologies for protein and peptide biomarker discovery, validation and assay development.

We are looking for an exceptionally qualified and highly motivated
Senior Mass Spectrometry Specialist (m/f/d)
to join our Mass Spectrometry team based on our ISO9001:2015 certified facility at Proteome Sciences R&D GmbH &Co. KG in Frankfurt am Main.

In this senior role, you will serve as the core technical anchor and operational subject matter expert for our Mass Spectrometry laboratory. You will combine deep technical expertise in LC-MS instrumentation and quantitative proteomics with strong project management, workflow optimization, and technical coordination responsibilities, driving technical excellence across client projects.
Independent operation, calibration, routine maintenance, and advanced troubleshooting of mass spectrometry and liquid chromatography (nano-LC) equipment.
Development, optimization, and execution of quantitative LC-MS methods (including TMT, DIA, DDA, and targeted studies) for client projects and R&D.
Technical oversight of project execution, capacity planning, and resource management in interaction with other teams to ensure timely delivery within budget.
Diligent tracking and initial quality control of MS raw data in close interaction with the Bioinformatics and wet-lab team.
Technical consulting and contribution to client communications, including project proposals, data presentations, and technical reports.
Guidance and technical support for laboratory personnel to maintain high operational standards and best laboratory practices.
Ensuring strict compliance of MS procedures with ISO9001:2015 and GCLP requirements.

Ph.D. with 2-5 years of professional, preferably industrial or CRO background, operating LC-MS systems in a proteomics environment.
Strong hands-on experience and deep technical knowledge of nano LC and MS applied to peptides and proteins, including advanced instrument operation and troubleshooting.
Solid proficiency with quantitative MS techniques (e.g., TMT, DIA, DDA, PRM).
Expert-level knowledge of proteomic data processing software (e.g., Proteome Discoverer, DIA-NN, Skyline)
Robust project coordination, time management, and organizational skills.
Excellent technical documentation skills and readiness to contribute to client reports and presentations.
Clear and proficient communication in written and spoken English.

Advantageous for the role:

First exposure to technical leadership, mentoring junior team members, or managing project workflows.
Working knowledge or fluency in German.
Familiarity with quality management requirements (ISO 9001, GxP).
Practical knowledge of programming and/or scripting tools such as Python and R.

A high-impact technical role at a market leading company in applied proteomics and biomarker discovery.
Challenging projects in collaboration with international pharma, biotech, and academic leaders.
A friendly, welcoming working atmosphere and support for professional development.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airframe Engineering, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Fatigue & Damage Tolerance Engineer (d/f/m)

Become part of a pioneering team with a strong identity and a shared commitment to delivering best-in-class stress solutions!

​Join the Fuselage Structure Analysis team in Hamburg as a technical anchor in our newly integrated "One Fuselage" domain. As the Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) Engineer for Primary Structure, you will will have the chance of contributing to the structural integrity, driving the F&DT justification for critical fuselage components across the entire aircraft lifecycle—from next-generation design and certification to manufacturing and global fleet support.

You will grow into a technical expert, collaborating with a high-level network to integrate advanced simulations and structural health strategies. We are looking for a motivated, curious engineer driven by a "People First" spirit to help us create the future of aerospace excellence.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Structural Analysis: Analyze and Validate composite & hybrid structures for Fatigue and Damage Tolerance according to validated methods.
- Airworthiness & Maintenance Criteria: Ensure adherence to relevant regulations, relevant design principles, processes, methods and manufacturing capabilities guidelines.
- Structural Testing: Participate in the planning and analysis of fatigue tests, helping to validate theoretical models with real-world data
- Cross-Functional Certification: Collaborate with Design, Materials, and Stress teams to learn how F&DT requirements are integrated into the earliest design phases
- Support Fleet In-Service Solutions: Provide stress analysis for the repair/acceptance of damaged structures
- Manage Technical Project Deliverables: Define technical scopes, workload sizing, and lead times, ensuring high-quality inputs and the mitigation of technical risks/opportunities
- Continuous Innovation & Method Improvement: Contribute to the evolution of internal analysis tools and structural health monitoring strategies.

​In essence, you will support the delivery of technical outputs in Time, Cost, and Quality, guided by senior experts and technical leadears.

Desired skills and qualifications
